mapper.select: SELECT volunteer_id AS volunteerId, user_id AS userId, title, description, location, image_path AS imagePath, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, max_participants AS maxParticipants, status, reject_reason AS rejectReason, current_people AS currentPeople, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, view_count AS viewCount FROM volunteer WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at DESC
